name: copilot-goal-system
description: Manual goal mode with persisted state, drift blocking, and proof-based completion for GitHub Copilot CLI.
author: Soroush Yousefpour

scripts.check: node --check extension.mjs && node --check lib/goal-core.mjs && node --check scripts/install.mjs && node --check scripts/check-release.mjs && bash -n install.sh && bash -n scripts/install.sh && bash -n hooks/goal-context.sh && jq . package.json plugin.json hooks.json .github/hooks/goal-system.json >/dev/null
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run release:check && npm test
